Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing school districts and other educational entities to require background investigations and screenings for employees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to background investigations and screenings forcertain educational employees; and adding a new section to chapter28A.400 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.400RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) School districts, educational service districts, the Washingtonstate center for childhood deafness and hearing loss, the state schoolfor the blind, and their contractors may require backgroundinvestigations and screenings in addition to the record checks throughthe Washington state patrol criminal identification system and federalbureau of investigation that are required under RCW 28A.400.303. (2) Within existing funds, the superintendent of public instructionshall issue a request for proposal for persons or entities willing toconduct background investigations and screenings for interested schooldistricts and others. (3) The persons or entities selected by the superintendent ofpublic instruction shall contract directly with interested schooldistricts and others. p. 1 HB 1934 (4) The office of the superintendent of public instruction shallinform school districts, educational service districts, the Washingtonstate center for childhood deafness and hearing loss, and the stateschool for the blind, as well as approved private schools and federalbureau of Indian affairsfunded schools, of the services and ratesnegotiated with the persons or entities for various kinds of backgroundinvestigations and screenings and shall make this information availableon its web site.
